mapper.select: SELECT r.region_id, r.code, r.name, r.sort_no, COUNT(c.course_id) AS course_count FROM region r LEFT JOIN course c ON c.region_id = r.region_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY r.region_id, r.code, r.name, r.sort_no ORDER BY r.sort_no, r.region_id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM region WHERE region_id = #{regionId})
SELECT region_id, code, name, sort_no, created_at FROM region ORDER BY sort_no
